descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S03 Existing spec: row status on file × dictated cue → outcome, and the dose-change rename (pre-round merge)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated. (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 R5)
  • U8 Hold/stop dates and reasons are the ones dictated and are kept on every later save; they are never changed to the save date. (UAT TC-19 ER 5; UAT TC-19 ER 10; TFA-92597 R6)
  • U5 A conditional or future order ('restart tomorrow if K is fine') never changes today's status. (UAT TC-19 ER 2; TFA-92597 R1)
  • U7 A dose change renames the row to the new dose and keeps its history (the old dose stays readable on the row). (UAT TC-19 ER 4; TFA-92597 R7)
  • U10 Same drug in two forms → two rows; brand/generic → one row. (UAT TC-19 ER 7; TFA-92597 R8; TFA-94229 R6)
  • U11 'Gave one-time X' → a single-dose row shown as Given that expires; the standing order of the same drug is untouched. (UAT TC-19 ER 8; TFA-92597 R2)
  • T4 A restarted or resumed medication no longer shows stale 'held' language, on the tracker or in the note. (TFA-94655 AC 3)
  • U19 Never invent: no tracker row, pre-round output or note contains a drug, indication, unit or status that was not dictated or stored, and none narrates documentation status ('dose not specified in dict … (UAT 3.4; TFA-94229 R8)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Rows on file held, stopped or active; the pre-round extractor's output scripted (no model)

When Merge each cell: held × conditional restart, held × plain mention, held × new dose, stopped × model says active, held × dictated restart, held × stop, held × negated restart, stopped × started again this morning, held × one-time dose, stopped × stop re-reported, held × hold re-dictated, held × restarted today; …

Then Held stays held unless a restart is dictated (then active, 'Started · today', old hold date gone); a stopped row stays stopped unless restarted; a re-reported stop or hold leaves the row identical (original date and reason); a one-time dose of a held drug is its own Given row and the held row is untouched; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions (toEqual on the unchanged cells, toMatchObject on status/changeType/changeDate/changedNote). Code layer of the pre-round path only: the encounter event path is S04, S11 and S14. 'V2 the same one-time dose read twice…' is the code layer of S07's same-text-again save; 'a drug the dictation never names…' is the code layer of S15 E-12/E-13. …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method UNIT · Unit test; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: UNIT · Unit test — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).
